scope: Original iPad action-compatibility captures inspected by the primary agent.

captures.observed: After confirmed selected Item deletion, Zulu is selected in the descending catalog and its own notes appear in the detail pane.
After confirmed selected List deletion, Zulu contents and its first sorted Birch appearance are selected. Detail retains In Zulu and the contextual notes; full count is two.
Manual order shows Zulu, Alpha, Middle. Zulu remains locally checked and full progress is one of three.
Portrait draft keeps title, subtitle, notes, 12-hour estimate, owned location and link; Origin remains the visible surrounding List.
Landscape returns to the same unsaved draft with its duration, owned address and link retained in native Form rows beside Origin. The view is scrolled below the title fields.

limits: These light-mode captures qualify selected layouts, not final whole-app visual/accessibility acceptance.
Rotation supplies no Mac resize, cross-window, physical performance or signing credit.
